analysis.rationale: Single-step deterministic JPEG. block_boundary=1.259 (>1.05, 0% FP) confirmed compression; unique_G=256 rules out strong quantization; variance_ratio=0.991 / mean_shift=0.1 / saturation_chroma_ratio=0.983 rule out global; gm_ratio=0.942 and spectral_slope_ratio=0.994 rule out blur; noise_prior sigma=0.62 (<2) and peeled residual std=0.0 rule out noise. compression_jpeg:1 reproduces every degraded pair bit-exactly (pair0-4: PSNR=inf dB, CI 10/10, all ten metric diffs 0.000), i.e. 5/5 support verification.
